comment: The one ffmpeg every build, CI job and `make ffmpeg` uses. BtbN keeps each month's last autobuild long-term, so pin to one of those. To upgrade: pick a newer month-end autobuild-YYYY-MM-DD-* release at https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases, copy the *-linux64-gpl-X.Y.tar.xz / *-win64-gpl-X.Y.zip names and their sha256 digests here, and let CI render-test it. The macOS entries are eugeneware/ffmpeg-static b6.1.1 (static, GPL, libass + x264; built with --enable-nonfree, so VidGrab never bundles it: the app downloads it on first use, checking these SHA-256s).
